entries.code_description: Carriages for disabled persons, whether or not motorised or otherwise mechanically propelled
entries.comment: Comments Certain Medical equipment, aids and their parts are at the 0% VAT rate. This includes, invalid carriages, orthopaedic appliances, surgical belts, artificial limbs, artificial parts of the body,  and deaf aids, walking frames, crutches, and parts of same. This does not include artificial teeth, corrective spectacles, or contact lenses. For specific queries, more detail can be found on the Revenue Commissioner's VAT Rates Database - https://www.revenue.ie/en/vat/vat-rates/index.aspx

entries.category_description: Medical equipment, aids and other appliances normally intended to alleviate or treat disability, for the exclusive personal use of the disabled, including the repair of such goods
entries.code_description: Carriages for disabled persons, whether or not motorised or otherwise mechanically propelled
entries.comment:
Tabel I prov. a.34 and b.1: carriages and crutches for the disabled; stand-up chairs; high-low beds. A vehicle for the disabled is defined as a means of transport that is designed to be used by a disabled person. The term can also include motor vehicles which are equipped for use by a disabled person. 

Only carriages that within social standards are regarded as a vehicle for the invalid on the basis of its destination and presentation are included.
